description: This file defines the AvroFileFormat class for Apache Spark, implementing file reading, schema inference, and writing support for Avro data sources within Spark SQL. It includes methods for building record readers, schema handling, and registering custom Avro types.

classes.name: AvroFileFormat
classes.description: Implements Spark's FileFormat for Avro data, supporting schema inference, reading, writing, and custom type registration.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on class type.

methods.name: isSplitable
methods.description: Indicates if files are splitable; always true.

methods.name: prepareWrite
methods.description: Prepares output writer for writing Avro data.

methods.name: buildReader
methods.description: Builds a function to read Avro files into InternalRows, handling schema, filters, and resource management.

methods.name: supportDataType
methods.description: Checks if a data type is supported.

methods.name: supportFieldName
methods.description: Validates field names for Avro compatibility.
